name: Leistungsbot
short_desc: Telegram poll bot for the weekly Leistungstag
author: EckPhi
description: Telegram bot that runs the recurring Leistungstag of a chat group: it posts the location poll, keeps a curated location list backed by the Google Places API (opening hours, ratings, address), sends reminders and reservation nudges on a schedule, closes the previous poll and dumps a weekly database backup into a backup chat. It can also keep a Google Calendar in step with the leistungstage. State lives in a single SQLite file under app-data, so there is no database container. Headless — the bot is operated from Telegram, not from a web UI.

form_fields.label: Google Maps API key
form_fields.hint: Google Places API key. Used for location search, opening hours and ratings.

form_fields.label: Leistungschat ID
form_fields.hint: Chat the polls and reminders are posted in, e.g. -1001234567890. Send /showIds in the chat to read it.

form_fields.label: Leistungsadmin ID
form_fields.hint: Chat/user the scheduler reports to, e.g. the admin's own chat ID.

form_fields.label: Log chat ID
form_fields.hint: Private chat or group that receives errors and log output.

form_fields.label: Bot operator usernames
form_fields.hint: Telegram usernames allowed to run the privileged commands, without @. Separate several with spaces.

form_fields.label: Backup chat ID
form_fields.hint: Optional chat the weekly SQLite backup is uploaded to. Leave empty to disable.

form_fields.label: Google Calendar ID
form_fields.hint: Optional. Calendar the leistungstage are written to, e.g. abc123@group.calendar.google.com (Calendar settings → Integrate calendar). Leave empty to keep no calendar.

form_fields.label: Google service account key
form_fields.hint: Path inside the container to the service account json, e.g. /config/google-service-account.json. Put the file in app-data/data/config and share the calendar with the account's email address as "Make changes to events".

form_fields.label: Calendar timezone
form_fields.hint: Optional IANA zone for the calendar entries, e.g. Europe/Vienna. Leave empty to use the app's timezone.

form_fields.label: Config file
form_fields.hint: Leave empty to configure the bot purely from the fields above (recommended). Set /config/BotConfig.yml to additionally read app-data/data/config/BotConfig.yml; the fields above still win over the file.

form_fields.label: Database path
form_fields.hint: Path inside the container. /data is app-data/data/storage on the host.
